title: Baida Roti
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -Hari mirch (Green chilli) finely chopped ½ tbs
steps.romanUrdu: -Hari mirch (Green chilli) finely chopped ½ tbs

steps.instruction: -Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chilli) powder 1 tsp
steps.romanUrdu: -Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chilli) powder 1 tsp

steps.instruction: -Iodized Himalayan pink salt 1 tsp or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Iodized Himalayan pink salt 1 tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: -Lal mirch powder (Red chilli powder) 1 tsp or to taste
steps.romanUrdu: -Lal mirch powder (Red chilli powder) 1 tsp or to taste

steps.instruction: In a wok,add cooking oil,onion & sauté for a minute.
steps.romanUrdu: -Karahi mein cooking oil aur pyaz dal ker ek minute kliya sauté ker lein. -Hari mirch aur adrak lehsan dal kar mix karein aur medium flame par sauté karein jab tak pyaz translucent ho jaye. -Tomato paste dal ker ache sa mix karein. -Pani,kashmiri lal mirch powder,zeera,pink salt,garam masala powder,lal mirch powder,kali mirch aur lemon juice dal kar mix karein aur medium flame par cook karein jab tak oil separate ho jaye. -Chicken aur hara dhania dal ker ache sa mix karein aur 2-3 minutes tak paka lein. -Thanda ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Add green chilli,ginger garlic,mix well & sauté on medium flame until onions are translucent.
steps.romanUrdu: -130g dough le kar ball banayein,dry flour sprinkle karein aur rolling pin ki madad se bilkul patla roll karein. -Dough ke center mein chicken filling rakhein.

-Ek bowl mein anday,kali mirch aur pink salt dal kar whisk karein. -Ab 2 tbs pheeta huwa anda,pyaz,hara dhania,hari mirch aur cheddar cheese slice rakhein aur dough ke charon sides fold karke whisked anday laga kar seal karein.

steps.instruction: -Add water,kashmiri red chilli powder,cumin seeds,pink salt,garam masala powder,red chilli powder, black pepper,lemon juice,mix well & cook on medium flame until oil separates.
steps.romanUrdu: -Tawa per cooking oil garam karein aur dono sides se halki ancch per golden ho janay tak fry ker lein (makes 3-4).

steps.instruction: -Add chicken,fresh coriander,mix well & cook for 2-3 minutes.
-Take 130g of dough,make a ball,sprinkle dry flour & roll out with the help of rolling pin (as thin as possible).
-In the center of the dough,add chicken filling.
-In a bowl,add eggs,black pepper,pink salt & whisk well.
-Add 2 tbs of whisked eggs,onion,fresh coriander,green chilli,cheddar cheese slice & fold all sides of dough,apply whisked eggs & seal properly.
-On a griddle,heat cooking oil & fry on low flame from both sides until golden (makes 3-4).

ogDescription: Make your Ramzan extra special with this golden, flaky Baida Roti! A satisfying recipe that’s perfect for Suhoor, Iftar, or even late-night cravings.
